data.answer:
Centrally positioned, the community provides easy access to various major landmarks and commercial hubs. Residents also benefit from the proximity to the pristine beaches and resorts in Jumeirah. For those who commute regularly, Al Hudaiba offers direct connectivity to Dubai Maritime City via Sheikh Rashid Road (D75), making it a convenient option for work and leisure.

The area primarily offers affordable rental properties, with apartments being the most common rental option. Although villas are available, they tend to be rare to come by. Al Hudaiba Dubai’s location is particularly convenient for professionals working in nearby parts of Bur Dubai or at the Dry Docks situated to the west, allowing easy transit to essential work and leisure spots within the city. Thanks to its blend of affordable living, accessibility, and a welcoming environment, Al Hudaiba Dubai attracts a mix of singles, couples, and small families.

Properties available in Al Hudaiba mainly consist of well-appointed 1 and 2-bedroom apartments. A standard 1-bedroom unit usually offers two bathrooms and spans approximately 890 sq. ft. of living space.

Larger variations of these 1-bedroom apartments are also available, offering even more generous floor plans, such as those with 900 sq. ft. or up to 1,205 sq. ft. of covered area.

Popular Buildings in Al Hudaiba

Al Hudaiba is home to some notable buildings that are popular among residents and investors alike. One such building is the Al Hudaiba Awards Building, renowned for its architectural elegance and central location.

Off-Plan Projects in Al Hudaiba

The Al Hudaiba area is witnessing the rise of exciting off-plan projects that promise modern living spaces and innovative designs. Projects like the Hudaiba Residential Building offer potential buyers and investors an opportunity to purchase at competitive prices, with units typically starting from AED 1.2 million for a one-bedroom apartment. These projects are designed to cater to a luxurious lifestyle, featuring state-of-the-art facilities and high-end finishes.

Renting a Property in Al Hudaiba

Renting in Al Hudaiba offers a range of options from luxurious apartments to more modest accommodations. The average rent for a one-bedroom apartment in this district starts at around AED 50,000 per year, providing access to vibrant community life and excellent amenities.

Buying a Property in Al Hudaiba

Buying a property in Al Hudaiba can be a lucrative investment, with a variety of residential options available. Sale prices for apartments start at approximately AED 800,000 for a one-bedroom unit, reaching upwards depending on the size and exclusivity of the property.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Al Hudaiba, Dubai?

data.answer:
Life in Al Hudaiba, Dubai, combines urban convenience with cultural richness, featuring accessible amenities, bustling markets, and serene residential areas, all within a short distance from the city's vibrant heart.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Al Hudaiba

Parking in Al Hudaiba Street Satwa typically includes a dedicated covered spot if you reside in one of the local apartment buildings. For those without this amenity, paid street parking is available.

Navigating public transportation in Al Hudaiba, it's worth noting that there is no metro station directly within the community. The nearest, Max Fashion Metro Station, is just 2 km away, a short 6-minute drive. The area is well-serviced by buses, with several stops along its perimeter. Commuters can take the feeder bus F12 directly to Max Fashion Metro Station. For broader city access, buses C14, C01, C10, 28, 93, and 15 are available, while the X13 route serves multiple stops within Al Hudaiba itself.

Supermarkets in and Around Al Hudaiba

Al Hudaiba, though compact, boasts a variety of supermarkets catering to everyday shopping needs. On Al Hudaiba Road, you'll find Talal Supermarket, known for its weekend specials on fresh meats and produce. Nearby, Choithrams anchors Ghazal Mall, offering a wide selection of goods, while Baqer Mohebi Supermarket is famed for its quality vegetables and meats.

For those preferring Carrefour, a 24-hour outlet at Hana Center near Chelsea Plaza provides a comprehensive department store experience. Additionally, Almaya Supermarket, Your Choice Supermarket, and West Zone Supermarket are other convenient options in the neighborhood, ensuring residents have multiple choices for their grocery needs right on Al Hudaiba Road.

Shopping Malls Near Al Hudaiba

While the community itself doesn't feature any large shopping malls, Al Ghazal Mall, located nearby on the corner of Al Hudaiba and Al Badaa along 2nd of December Street, serves the community well. This medium-sized mall houses a selection of retail stores along with several cafés and restaurants, making it an ideal spot for those who prefer not to travel far for shopping and dining. For those in need of essentials, Al Hanaa Center in Al Hudaiba offers a convenient one-stop-shop for all basic necessities.

Driving a bit further south from Al Hudaiba, you can explore the array of community malls in Jumeirah, such as Palm Strip Mall, Jumeira Plaza, Mercato Mall, and Town Centre Jumeirah, each offering unique shopping and dining experiences.

Additionally, Dubai Mall is just an 11-minute drive away and stands out not only for its extensive array of shops and restaurants but also for its thrilling entertainment options, making it a premier destination for visitors and residents alike.

Schools and Nurseries in and Near Al Hudaiba

In Al Hudaiba, Dubai, the Dubai Early Childhood Development Centre (DECDC) stands out for its commitment to children with special needs. Housed in Block C of the Al Hudaiba Awards Building, DECDC offers comprehensive early intervention programs, educational services, and conducts training and awareness campaigns.

Nearby, the Special Needs Future Development Center provides specialized education, while the Ambassador School on Al Hudaiba Road is celebrated for its excellence in math, biology, computer studies, and commercial activities, earning accolades for its educational quality.

For younger children, Dubai Gem Private Nursery and New Dubai Nursery offer early education options within Al Hudaiba. Ambassador Kindergarten is another esteemed choice for early learning nearby.

Additional educational facilities include New Academy School in Al Raffa, offering an American curriculum, and Ambassador School in Al Mankhool, which follows the Indian curriculum. For higher education, Al Falah University and The American College of Dubai are accessible in Al Garhoud, providing advanced academic programs.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Al Hudaiba

The area boasts two prominent mosques along its streets. The Mosque of Omar Ibn Al-Khattab, located near the Consulate General of Sri Lanka on Al Hudaiba Street, and another mosque situated just behind the Carrefour Market in Satwa. 

Additionally, the iconic Jumeirah Mosque, a mere 4-minute drive away, stands as one of Dubai's most stunning architectural marvels. Known for its beautiful ambiance and large capacity, it's also one of the few mosques in the UAE that offers tours to non-Muslims, making it a significant tourist landmark as well.

For those in Al Hudaiba who are part of church-going communities, nearly all nearby churches are located in Oud Metha, about a 10-minute drive away. This area hosts 12 churches close to one another, with St. Mary’s Catholic Church, St. Thomas Orthodox Cathedral, and Holy Trinity Church being prominent options.

Hindu residents have convenient access to places of worship such as Shiva Temple, Shree Krishna Haveli, and ShrinathJi Temple in the neighboring Bur Dubai, a brief 5-minute drive from Al Hudaiba. In addition to these temples, Bur Dubai also houses the Sikh Gurudwara and the Sindhi Gurdarbar, catering to the Sikh community.

Clinics and Hospitals in and Near Al Hudaiba

Al Hudaiba hosts approximately six to seven medical clinics, with GlobeHealth General Clinic being the most frequented. Located in Al Hudaiba, Dubai, this clinic provides a range of medical services including gynecology, dentistry, and general health check-ups. Other notable clinics in the area include Dr. Ali Jafar Clinic (Surgical)-DUBAI, Najmat Al Shatea Polyclinic, and Real Smile Dental Clinic.

For those seeking hospital care, Belhoul European Hospital is the nearest facility, situated on the first floor of the Dune Center Building, south of Al Hudaiba. This private hospital boasts state-of-the-art medical technology and facilities. Additionally, the International Modern Hospital is located at the northern end of the community, offering advanced tertiary care and specialized treatments.

Location & Nearby Areas

Just west of the neoghborhood, along Al Hudaiba Road, lies the Al Mina community, notable for housing Drydocks World. Adjacent to Port Rashid, this facility specializes in marine and offshore maintenance services.

To the immediate east of Al Hudaiba is Al Jafiliya, known for its consulate offices and convenient metro station access. Northward, the Bur Dubai sub-communities of Al Mankhool and Al Raffa offer a vibrant urban experience. Towards the south, the tranquil villa communities of Jumeirah 1 and Al Badaa boast extensive amenities, enhancing the residential appeal. Overall, Al Hudaiba is strategically nestled among some of Dubai's most well-established neighborhoods.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Al Hudaiba

data.answer:
Discover the vibrant lifestyle of Al Hudaiba, where cultural experiences and leisure activities blend seamlessly in the heart of Dubai.

Restaurants

Al Hudaiba is a culinary hotspot, offering a rich selection of about 17 restaurants within its confines. From global flavors at Chin Chin and Truck Adda, to local favorites like Al Mallah, known for having one of the best shawarmas in Dubai, the neighborhood caters to all tastes. Additionally, notable Korean dining options like Manna Land are readily available.

For buffet enthusiasts, spots like Lal Qila, Grand Barbecue, and Bar B. Q. Tonight near the Al Hudaiba Awards Building provides a variety of cuisines, with Grand Barbecue acclaimed for its North Indian dishes.

The area's nightlife and standard of living keep things far from dull. Residents can unwind at The Docks, a Scottish pub in the Ramada by Wyndham Jumeirah Hotel, known for its happy hour and casual vibe with outdoor seating. More lively evenings can be had at Capitol Hotel’s venues like Xanadu nightclub, Olympic Sports Club, and Czar Club. Moreover, for those who enjoy shisha, the Shisha Lounge in Al Hudaiba Awards Building, Block C, is celebrated as one of the top spots in Dubai.

Beaches Near Al Hudaiba

Al Hudaiba is close to several beach options, with Jumeirah Public Beach being the nearest. This iconic beach spot, one of Dubai's oldest, attracts both residents and tourists. It features a walkway perfect for strolls at any time of day, complemented by various food stalls. For a more refined experience, visitors can enjoy upscale restaurants and cafes along the beachfront, ideal for relaxing with a hot coffee after a day in the sun. Safety is a priority here, with dedicated lifeguards ensuring a secure swimming environment for families.

For a more exclusive beach experience, Nikki Beach Resort & Spa Dubai near Al Mina offers a private beach section. The Beach Club at Nikki Beach is particularly popular on weekends and requires paid admission.

Hotels in Al Hudaiba

Al Hudaiba hosts several notable hotels, including the five-star Ramada by Wyndham Jumeirah situated on Mina Road, which is approximately 2.9 km away from the bustling Jumeirah Public Beach. 
Nearby, one can also find the Jumeirah Rotana and Chelsea Plaza hotels, adding to the accommodation options in the area. Additionally, the four-star Hilton Garden Inn on Al Mina is a popular choice, renowned for its Sky Garden, a top-rated shisha lounge in Dubai.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Although Al Hudaiba doesn't have its own community parks, nearby Al Mankhool Park, just a 5-minute drive away, offers a tranquil setting with plenty of shaded seating—ideal for families to relax and watch their children play.

For those seeking a larger green space, Zabeel Park is also close by, about a 7-minute drive from Al Hudaiba. This expansive park is packed with diverse entertainment options and facilities, making it a perfect recreational spot for both children and adults.

Fitness enthusiasts have several gym options in Al Hudaiba, including Al Bawasel Gym, V.I.P. Gym, and First Choice Body Fitness Club.

Beauty and wellness are also well catered to in the area, with salons like Station 10 Beauty Salon, Beauty Lady Salon, and Bodyline Ladies Spa and Salon available for women, and Salsa Gents Center, Solitaire Gents Salon & Spa, and Casanova Gents Salon providing grooming services for men. This array of amenities enhances the lifestyle quality in Al Hudaiba, despite the absence of a local park.

Community Events

Al Hudaiba is a vibrant hub for community events that cater to the diverse interests of its residents. Throughout the year, the neighborhood hosts a variety of cultural festivals, markets, and social gatherings that bring the community together. These events are often held in easily accessible locations like the Al Hudaiba Awards Building or nearby parks, providing a perfect setting for residents to interact, share experiences, and celebrate the rich cultural tapestry of Dubai. 

Attractions and Landmarks

The Al Hudaiba Awards Building stands as a prominent landmark in the area, encompassing three large mixed-use structures that host a variety of commercial shops, offices, and retail spaces. A notable feature outside the building is a statue within a water fountain, depicting a sinking ship, which has become a favored spot for evening strolls.

Al Hudaiba is also near significant cultural landmarks, such as Union House, located just outside the community. This historic site is where the unification documents of the United Arab Emirates were signed. It's part of the Etihad Museum, which not only houses a wealth of traditional items and cultural exhibits but also includes a library, an educational center, and an events venue.

While there are no golf courses directly within Al Hudaiba, the Dubai Creek Golf and Yacht Club is only a 15-minute drive away. This club offers a range of golfing experiences: a 9-hole Par 3 course suitable for beginners, the challenging 18-hole, par 71 Championship Course favored by professionals, and the fun #minigolfdubai Course, ideal for players of all ages and skill levels.

When considering a move to Al Hudaiba, prospective residents should note the area's well-rounded amenities and strategic location. The neighborhood boasts a plethora of dining options, ranging from local delicacies to international cuisines, and the proximity to major shopping centers and cultural landmarks enhances the appeal. The area's connectivity is facilitated by excellent transportation links, including nearby metro stations and bus services, ensuring easy access to the rest of Dubai. Additionally, Al Hudaiba's close-knit community atmosphere and regular social events make it an ideal choice for those seeking a vibrant and engaging lifestyle.

Is Al Hudaiba suitable for expatriates? 

Al Hudaiba is a favored spot among expatriates due to its multicultural environment, variety of international cuisines, and expat-friendly residential options.

What facilities are available for elderly residents in Al Hudaiba? 

The community offers several senior-friendly facilities, including health clubs, senior social clubs, and easy access to medical care tailored to the needs of older residents.

Are there community gardens or green initiatives in Al Hudaiba? 

While Al Hudaiba doesn’t have its own community parks, it participates in various green initiatives like community gardening projects and environmental awareness programs, often held in collaboration with local environmental groups.

data.content:
Al Hudaiba is a compact yet vibrant community that boasts an array of hotels, shopping centers, consulates, and various points of interest. The area caters well to everyday needs by offering everything from quality education and reliable healthcare to diverse recreational options, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle for its residents.

One of the community’s most appealing features is its close proximity to Drydocks World near Al Mina, a factor that significantly enhances its allure. This convenient location, combined with a selection of affordable rental apartments, makes the neighborhood especially attractive to young expats seeking a modern, accessible living environment.

Strategically situated, Al Hudaiba is nestled near some of the city’s most desirable locales. It lies adjacent to areas like Al Jafiliya and Jumeirah 1, with the communities of Pearl Jumeirah and Al Mina to its west. To the north, several notable parts of Bur Dubai—including Al Raffa, Al Mankhool, and Al Karama—further underscore its prime location within the urban landscape.
